name: Sarah Mitchell
bio: Over 18 years in luxury residential real estate across the Bay Area. Sarah has closed more than $420M in volume and is known for discretion and precision.

name: David Okonkwo
bio: David specialises in new developments and investment portfolios. He built the firm’s first-time buyer programme from zero to 900 clients in four years.

name: Elena Ruiz
bio: Corporate relocation specialist helping families and executives settle into new cities. Elena has coordinated over 1,200 corporate moves.

name: Marcus Lee
bio: Marcus leads the commercial division covering retail, office and mixed-use assets, with an emphasis on adaptive-reuse development in historic districts.
